summary: LifeOS v1.0.0 — Live on Google Play (May 26, 2026). All-in-one life management app powered by Zoe, your AI life guide. Health, Finance, Mental Health, Fitness, Nutrition, Family, Travel, and Emergency — all in one unified platform. Three-tier access: Free + Premium ($4.99 one-time) + Professional (subscription). https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.equalinformation.lifeos.app
included: Health — steps, weight, heart rate, water intake
Finance — budget, expenses, goals
Mental Health — mood, journal, stress tracking
Fitness — workouts, progress, plans
Nutrition — food log, barcode scanner, macros (Premium)
Family — schedule, shared contacts (Premium)
Travel — trips, itineraries (Premium)
Emergency — SOS, location sharing, emergency contacts
Zoe AI — voice-powered AI life guide (configurable API key, keyword mode when no AI configured)
Three-tier IAP: Free + Premium ($4.99 one-time) + Pro ($9.99/mo or $79.99/yr)
Institutional licensing via equalinformation.com
100% offline-first, all data on-device, no account required
Android (Jetpack Compose), versionCode 5, v1.0.0
Package ID: com.equalinformation.lifeos.app

summary: LifeOS v0.9.0 — all 44 modules wired and building on iOS (SwiftUI) and Android (Jetpack Compose). 100% offline-first, on-device SQLite, optional external AI via user-configured API keys.
included: 44 full-featured modules across Health, Finance, Fitness, Nutrition, Family, Travel, Emergency, and Professional tiers
100% offline-first, all data on-device SQLite — no cloud required
Optional external AI via user-provided API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
Voice input (offline STT) and TTS as first-class features on every module
iOS (SwiftUI) and Android (Jetpack Compose) build successfully with zero errors
Deployed to internal test devices
